findings.label: "Dodaj dla kogoś innego" button invisible
findings.description: color: white !important inside a white frosted card body (rgba(255,255,255,0.78)) with rgba(255,255,255,0.2) button background produces near-zero contrast. Change color to #2d3748 and drop text-shadow, or give the button a contrasting non-white background.

findings.label: .btn-transparent-blur placement context mismatch
findings.description: The class is designed for dark/photographic backgrounds (white text, translucent white fill). It is used inside a light frosted card without adjustment. Issue 1 fixes the immediate legibility problem; the class should be renamed or a light-background variant added to prevent future misuse.

findings.label: styles.css still loaded on home.html
findings.description: home.html loads both styles.css and styles.deduped.min.css. The page-level overrides win the cascade today but depend on load order and specificity. Remove the styles.css link from home.html's head since styles.deduped.min.css covers all the same rules.
